chunks: And from his sermon (peace be upon him), in which he censures the followers of Satan.
ai.seo_question: What is the main theme of Imam Ali's sermon regarding the followers of Satan?
ai.summary: This heading introduces a sermon from Nahj al-Balagha where Imam Ali (AS) critiques the 'followers of Satan,' a concept deeply rooted in Shia exegesis as those who align with worldly desires over divine truth. It establishes a theological dichotomy between the 'Ahl al-Haqq' (People of Truth) and the 'Ahl al-Shaytan' (People of Satan), emphasizing that following Satan leads to spiritual deviation and eventual loss. The censure serves as a practical guide for believers to identify spiritual misguidance through adherence to ego and materialism.
